# Coutto Sew / 纽扣缝纫

> Projector sewing and pattern cloud backup. View PLT, DXF, and PDF at real size, then cut, tile, print, and back up patterns in one app.

## Product
- [Chinese homepage](https://coutto.cn/): Features, downloads, and FAQ.
- [English homepage](https://coutto.app/en/): Features, downloads, and FAQ.

## Tutorials
- [Chinese tutorials](https://coutto.cn/tutorials/): Guides for projector sewing and using the app.
- [English tutorials](https://coutto.app/en/tutorials/): Guides for projector sewing and using the app.
- [Chinese user guide](https://coutto.cn/zh/2026/09/coutto-pattern-app-user-guide/): Calibration and projection steps.
- [English user guide](https://coutto.app/en/2026/09/coutto-pattern-app-user-guide/): Calibration and projection steps.
- [Chinese projector guide](https://coutto.cn/zh/2026/09/how-to-choose-a-sewing-projector/): Throw ratio below 1.2:1, optical resolution of at least 720p, and mounting distance.
- [English projector guide](https://coutto.app/en/2026/09/how-to-choose-a-sewing-projector/): Throw ratio below 1.2:1, optical resolution of at least 720p, and mounting distance.
- [Chinese complete guide](https://coutto.cn/zh/2026/09/complete-guide-to-projector-sewing/): Four steps from choosing a projector to projecting and cutting.
- [English complete guide](https://coutto.app/en/2026/09/complete-guide-to-projector-sewing/): Four steps from choosing a projector to projecting and cutting.
